label: Popup
title: Popup
summary: Use a Popup for a short, focused moment, such as an offer or a reward, that slides up over the screen and asks for one choice.
corePrinciple: One short message and a choice, then back to the screen.

anatomy.title: A trigger, then a sheet over the screen
anatomy.description: Only the trigger sits in the page. Pressing it dims the whole screen with a scrim and slides up a white sheet with 20 px top corners and 24 px of space at the bottom. The sheet holds one centred stack of your content, with 8 px of padding and 8 px between items. Press the trigger to see them: React Native draws the popup over the page, so this diagram can’t frame it.
blocks: Yours: any pressable. Pressing it opens the popup over the whole screen.

anatomy.note: Yours: any pressable. Pressing it opens the popup over the whole screen.

configuration.title: How it opens, its scrim, and its spacing
configuration.description: A popup opens from its own trigger or when the screen sets it open. The scrim's strength is a setting. Modes on the popup reach its stack: Slot gap sets the space between items, and Page type the stack's padding.
blocks: The popup opens when its trigger is pressed and keeps its own open state.
The screen decides when it's open, for example after a payment, and hears every close.
30% black lets more of the page show through than the default 50%.
Slot gap L puts 24 px between the title and the buttons; the default, S, is 8 px.
On a sub page, or JioPlus, the stack's padding grows from 8 to 16 px.

states.title: Closed, open, and how it closes
states.description: Closed, only the trigger shows. Opening fades in the scrim while the sheet springs up from the bottom; closing slides it down and fades the scrim over 250 ms. A tap on the scrim, Escape, or a button in the sheet closes it, and focus stays inside while it's open.
blocks: Later closes it from inside; Claim would carry on with the task.
Only Later or Escape closes it; a tap on the dimmed page does nothing.

sources.title: Use the public Popup contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (16 October build) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s Popup is a 360 × 508 white sheet with 20 px top corners and 24 px at the bottom, holding an image, a title, and two buttons; it has no scrim or properties. In code it’s a React Native Modal: on the web it opens over the whole browser window, never inside a frame, so these examples open it from a button, as Storybook does. The sheet spans the window, its scrim is 50% black from props (Overlay’s is 70%), and it springs up but slides away over its close speed. On the web Escape closes it, and focus moves into the sheet and stays there. Since the #268 fix the dialog is named by accessibilityLabel (“Popup” by default), the scrim is never a Tab stop, the sheet stops at 90% of the window and scrolls, and the trigger takes the popup’s modes. The published Storybook page is still the old generated one.
